notes.content:
Beta version of iVRy Monado Tracker for SteamVR has been updated.

- Enable PSMove controller support

PSMove controllers must be paired to your computer before they will be recognised. To pair PSMove controllers, use the 'psmove' utility, found in the 'steamapps\common\iVRy\bin\win64' folder of your Steam installation, or an alternative. 

Pairing with 'psmove' is described here:

https://psmoveapi.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pairing.html

PSMove controllers use the same mappings as PSMoveSteamVRBridge. It is not necessary to install PSMoveService or PSMoveServiceSteamVRBridge.

notes.title: iVRy Driver for SteamVR (Smartphone & PSVR) Updated
notes.content:
iVRy Driver for SteamVR (Smartphone & PSVR) has been updated to version 1.1.4.6.

This build contains the following changes:
- Add 'laser mouse' support for using SteamVR dashboard with gamepads.
- Improve NoloVR tracking (only firmware from Nolo HOME 1.10 and later supported).
- Add PSMoveService tracking.
- Add Valve Lighthouse tracking.
- Improve PSVR distortion correction.
- Work around issues with non-compliant SteamVR drivers (eg. Trinus, KinoVR & Nolo HOME).
- Fix H264 'black screen' issue after reconnect with AMD GPUs.
- Fix PSVR VR-Direct mode issue where refresh rate was locked to 60Hz on AMD GPUs.
- Fix VR-Direct mode not working on AMD Vega and Navi GPUs.
- Automatically set "Extend desktop" and correct pixel format (AMD) so that no user action is needed.
- Fix issues with Bonjour installer.
- Quit SteamVR if PSVR is turned off or disconnected.
- Prompt user to install PSVR DLC if trying to use PSVR without DLC installed.
- Update UI to match SteamVR Settings.
- Fix connection/disconnection issues with Mobile devices.
- Add support for ADB USB debug connections for Android devices without USB tethering support.
- Various UI improvements and fixes. 
- Various bug fixes and improvements.

tags.feature: - Add 'laser mouse' support for using SteamVR dashboard with gamepads.
- Improve NoloVR tracking (only firmware from Nolo HOME 1.10 and later supported).
- Add PSMoveService tracking.
- Add Valve Lighthouse tracking.
- Improve PSVR distortion correction.
- Work around issues with non-compliant SteamVR drivers (eg. Trinus, KinoVR & Nolo HOME).

tags.bug: - Fix H264 'black screen' issue after reconnect with AMD GPUs.
- Fix PSVR VR-Direct mode issue where refresh rate was locked to 60Hz on AMD GPUs.
- Fix VR-Direct mode not working on AMD Vega and Navi GPUs.
- Automatically set "Extend desktop" and correct pixel format (AMD) so that no user action is needed.
- Quit SteamVR if PSVR is turned off or disconnected.
- Prompt user to install PSVR DLC if trying to use PSVR without DLC installed.

tags.feature: - Update UI to match SteamVR Settings.

tags.bug: - Fix connection/disconnection issues with Mobile devices.

tags.feature: - Add support for ADB USB debug connections for Android devices without USB tethering support.
